titles: At the Foot of the Stairs

hooks.text: "Every floor down there ends in a hall at the head of the next stair, and every hall has a guard. Break one."
"They hold the stairheads like a garrison. Of course they do. They were one. O. Hale."
"Somebody down there is still guarding the way down. Three hundred years on one door. I know the feeling."
"The halls by the stairs burn brightest. Stand in one long enough for the fire to notice you, and live."
"The old manuals say the legions put their best at the stairhead. We'd like to know if the manuals were right. The daughter."
"Whatever keeps the rest of them in step waits by the stairs down, on every floor. Break its rhythm."

label: Waves held in a stair hall
journal: Go down to the {floor} floor of the Old Barrows or deeper, find its stair hall (the room with the stairs down), and hold {n} waves there.
ready: Hand it in at the Lantern Guild's board, inside the Tired Mule in Thornwick.
done: The stair was held for three hundred years. Not any more.

titles: At the Foot of the Stairs

hooks.text: "Every floor of {site} ends in a hall, and every hall has a guard that hasn't moved in years. Move it."
"Those who keep the halls of {site} kept them for the empire. They needn't any longer. Tell them so, firmly."
"There's always a lamp burning in the halls of {site}. I'd like to know who's buying their oil."
"The hall at the bottom of the stair in {site} is where they gather. That's where you stand. That's what the coin is for."
"Hold the hall on the {floor} floor of {site} and drink here free that night. One drink. It's a small hall."
"Whatever keeps the rest of them in order sits by the stairs in {site}. Unsettle it."

fens.journal: Go to the {floor} floor of {site} or deeper, find its hall (at the stairs, or the last room), and hold {n} waves there.

fens.done: The hall stood empty for a night. In the Fens, that counts.
